pull_request.body:
## Purpose

Migrate the accepted consequence-bearing `windows_case_update_v1` procedure onto the CAP Core-v1 exact authorization path.

This PR is stacked on #172 exact head `a1f411ee51bb67f60ec7d8f9da8ede5c60829587`.

## Stage Research

`project-context/WINDOWS_CASE_GRANT_BINDING_REENTRY.md`

Decision: **NARROW**.

No Windows-specific policy engine, provider registry, retry subsystem, restart/resume protocol, public tool or Rust runtime is introduced.

## Core binding

One deterministic concrete grant is derived from:

- procedure id/version + accepted qualification admission;
- task id;
- active Windows qualification run id;
- exact source HEAD;
- exact case id;
- note SHA-256;
- requested status.

It authorizes exactly five existing action refs:

```text
select_case
focus_note
enter_note
set_status
save_case
```

Each physical transition now follows:

```text
persistent fresh Windows observation
 -> exact AttemptIntent
 -> Core LoopGuard.evaluate_authorized()
 -> one existing OpenAdapt/UIA/guarded-input delivery attempt
 -> fresh same-stream observation/settle
 -> Verification Kernel
 -> WorkingState.record_authorized_attempt()
 -> advance WorkingState observation
```

A final PASS records `VERIFIED_APPLIED`. A FAIL/UNKNOWN or unavailable post-effect observation records `OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` and the procedure stops. There is no blind retry.

Delivery errors are not converted into success merely because the final state happens to match: Core evidence is recorded, but the procedure still abstains on the delivery-contract error.

## Observation refinement

`windows_transition.py` now exposes `verify_windows_desktop_snapshots()` so one task-local `WindowsDesktopObservationStream` can remain monotonic across all five transitions.

The existing raw `verify_windows_desktop_transition()` API remains as a compatibility wrapper and keeps the same verification semantics.

## Persistence boundary

This PR does **not** add resume/restart.

The existing diagnostic/evidence checkpoint now carries current `WorkingState`, but a partially executed Windows case task is never automatically resumed or replayed. A later invocation receives a new task identity and must independently pass the existing clean-preflight contract.

The external Stage 26.3B Finish Gate remains mandatory and unresolved from inside the procedure.

## Installation

The Windows procedure bundle now explicitly carries the Core modules newly required by this consumer:

- `runtime/control_plane/__init__.py`
- `authorization.py`
- `verification.py`
- `working_state.py`

## Tests

Added/updated coverage proves:

- task/run/head/case/note/status are grant-bound;
- changed request/resource is blocked;
- only the fixed transition set can authorize;
- successful attempts consume Core budgets and advance one persistent evidence stream;
- unresolved attempt blocks any later physical transition;
- persistent snapshot verification remains compatible with existing Windows Verification Kernel semantics;
- Windows installed bundle contains the required Core dependencies;
- public six-tool schema and external Finish Gate remain unchanged.

## Sequencing

Keep Draft. Do not merge before #172 and its prerequisite Core chain are accepted/merged.

After prerequisite rebases, rerun applicable Stage Research bootstrap, exact-head CI, required fresh independent semantic review, and the target-Windows Case Desk L3 physical qualification because this PR changes the authority path immediately before real Windows effects.
